goal: Enables regtest developers to mine blocks with multiple coinbase outputs and custom payout amounts
Removes manual block construction workarounds when testing mining pool payouts like Ocean or Braidpool
Lets block generation automatically include mempool transactions when omitted
agreement: Strong support for simulating mining pools paying multiple coinbase recipients (supertestnet)
Open suggestion to split making arguments optional into a preparatory pull request (maflcko)
Open suggestion to require at least one output rather than allowing an empty list (achow101)

It benefits developers and testers experimenting with multi-recipient coinbases without manual block setup
